title: Real-Time Motion Planning with Dynamic Hazards: Classical vs. Learning-Based Methods
abstract: arXiv:2610.12249v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study real-time motion planning in dynamic hazard fields through a controlled comparison between classical planning and learning-based methods. Rather than introducing a new planner, we construct a unified benchmark in which representative classical and learning-based methods face the same environments, motion constraints, information assumptions, and evaluation metrics. The test environment consists of planar domains populated with rotating sprinkler-like hazards that generate time-varying forbidden regions via sweeping angular sectors. Our results show a clear regime shift. In deterministic environments, classical planners achieve near-perfect success and higher-quality paths, though sometimes at the cost of substantial planning or replanning time. translated_title: 动态危险环境下的实时运动规划：经典方法与基于学习方法的对比
translated_abstract: 我们通过对经典规划方法与基于学习方法进行受控比较，研究动态危险场中的实时运动规划。我们并不提出新的规划器，而是构建了一个统一的基准测试，让代表性的经典方法与基于学习的方法面对相同的环境、运动约束、信息假设和评估指标。测试环境由平面区域构成，其中布置了旋转的类似洒水器的危险源，这些危险源通过扫掠角度扇区产生随时间变化的禁区。我们的结果显示出明显的性能机制转变：在确定性环境中，经典规划器能够达到近乎完美的成功率并获得更高质量的路径，但有时需要付出大量的规划或重规划时间。然而，在随机障碍物动态下，在线搜索对计算预算高度敏感：低预算会导致频繁失败，而高预算则以延迟为代价换取成功率的提升。
tldr: 该论文构建了一个统一基准来对比经典规划与基于学习的运动规划方法，发现经典规划器在确定性环境中表现近乎完美，但在随机动态危险环境中其在线搜索对计算预算高度敏感，而学习式方法在此类场景下更具鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper builds a unified benchmark comparing classical and learning-based motion planners, showing that classical planners achieve near-perfect success in deterministic environments, while their online search becomes strongly budget-sensitive under stochastic hazard dynamics, where learning-based methods offer greater robustness.
